info.name: Zillapi: Zillow property data Buildings API
Get all units in a building

params.name: sync
params.description: When true (default) returns units synchronously. Set false for large buildings to run async and return a job_id.

items.docs: Extract all unit listings from a Zillow building, apartments, or community URL (/b/, /apartments/, or /community/). Runs synchronously by default; set sync=false for large buildings to receive a job_id. Billed at 1 credit per unit returned; failed calls are free.
